END OF TRAVEL BUFFER CHECK

All OK

Problems encountered

Operation

Raise the vehicle on a two column lift and raising the dust cover on the lower side of the support spring check that the end of travel buffer does not show signs of deterioration.

Move on to Step 3

End of travel buffer deteriorated

Replace the end of travel buffer

Op. 4410A12 FRONT SUSPENSION DAMPER (ONE), LH OR RH - FOR MCPHERSON STRUT SYSTEM - INCLUDES DISMANTLING/REASSEMBLY OF ASSEMBLY AT BENCH - R.R

3

TRACK CONTROL ARM BUSH CHECK

All OK

Problems encountered

Operation

Check the condition of the track control arm front and rear bush

In order to do so the guard under the engine must be removed

Op. 7055B54 UNDER ENGINE PROTECTION/GUARD - R.R.

Move on to Step 4

Front bush deteriorated.

Replace the track control arm

Op. 4410B40 LOWER TRACK CONTROL ARM (WITH BALLJOINT) FOR LEFT OR RIGHT FRONT SUSPENSION (ONE) - R+R - CHECK WHEEL GEOMETRY SEPARATELY

Rear bush deteriorated

Replace the rear bush

Op. 4410B52 FRONT SUSPENSION LOWER TRACK CONTROL ARM REAR BUSH LEFT OR RIGHT - REPLACE AT BENCH

4

SHOCK ABSORBER EFFICIENCY CHECK

All OK

Problems encountered

Operation

Check the efficiency of the shock absorbers by carrying out manual compression manoeuvres (resting on the bonnet by the centre of the wheel), which should be carried out on both sides of the vehicle.

Move on to Step 5

Sudden return without damping.

Replace the shock absorber that is not working properly

Op. 4410A12 FRONT SUSPENSION DAMPER (ONE), LH OR RH - FOR MCPHERSON STRUT SYSTEM - INCLUDES DISMANTLING/REASSEMBLY OF ASSEMBLY AT BENCH - R.R

5

All OK

After replacing the shock absorbers, check the geometry
